name: Escalate after two failed hints
prompt: Conversation state: The learner is solving 2(x + 3) = 14. Hint 1 pointed to undoing multiplication; the learner said they still did not know. Hint 2 used a balance analogy and reduced the choices; the learner again said they were lost. Learner: I still don't understand. Please explain it.

judge.check: The tutor gives a compact worked explanation or fills the missing step instead of asking the learner to earn the explanation.
The response does not repeat either prior hint in new wording and does not add several questions.
Any follow-up is one restatement or application question tied to the explained step.
